How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
menu

If your order includes live bees, they ship separately on the specific Monday ship date selected at checkout (Mason bees ship Mondays Feb–Apr, and Leafcutter bees ship Mondays May–Aug via FedEx 2-Day). Tracking emails are sent automatically as soon as the shipping label is generated.

What should I do if the tracking never updates?
menu
If your tracking number is stuck or hasn't updated, we ask that you wait 3 days, as delayed packages often show up or get delivered by a neighbor.
For live bees, please contact us the day after your expected delivery date if tracking hasn't updated.
If it still hasn't updated after that window, reach out to us with your order and tracking number, and we will issue a replacement for you.
Is there anything else I can help you with?

You can find your tracking link in the shipping confirmation email sent to you once your order's shipping label is generated.
If you have an account with us, you can also view your tracking details by logging into your account and selecting your order.
Be sure to check your spam or junk folder if you don't see the confirmation email in your inbox.

Can I reroute the package to a different address?
menu
Once an order has shipped, we aren't able to reroute or change the delivery address directly.
If your package hasn't shipped yet, you can submit a Help Center Support Ticket to request an address update before it goes out.
If it has already shipped, we recommend contacting the carrier (FedEx or USPS) directly with your tracking number to see if they can redirect or hold the package for you.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
